listing.name: The Last of Us Remastered (PS4 CUSA00552 update 1.11) / ravencaio PS4 host port
listing.summary: Unnoficial Native Windows PC port of The Last of Us Remastered (PS4, CUSA00552). Runs the game’s own x86-64 code on a custom runtime, with PS4 system libraries reimplemented and a Vulkan renderer based on shadPS4. Includes a launcher. No game files included: you need your own copy.
